1. Count the distinct colors of the image.
2. Choose the start centers, the color nearest to the mean and then the farthest colors.
3. Assign each color to its nearest center.
4. Move each center to the weighted mean of its colors.
5. Repeat the last two steps until no color changes cluster or the iterations run out.
6. Paint each pixel with its cluster's center or color.
